eligibility.include: every Internal Test claim with authentic annotated evidence yielding exactly one SUPPORT or CONTRADICT label
eligibility.excluded_handling: record count and processing status separately; never relabel as neutral, evidence-insufficient or abstained

no_relation_sensitivity.non_no_relation: eligible claims whose frozen E1 prediction is SUPPORT or CONTRADICT; rerank fixed scores within subset
no_relation_sensitivity.no_relation: report count, error count/rate and risk distributions; AUROC is undefined when only one y_error class exists
no_relation_sensitivity.predicted_category: report count, error rate, risk summaries and global-80 acceptance behavior for SUPPORT, CONTRADICT and NO_RELATION
no_relation_sensitivity.gold_label: post-hoc evaluation only; never a feature; use global 80 percent acceptance set

completeness.missing_eligible_prediction_or_risk: invalidate and stop the formal H1 evaluation
completeness.nonfinite_score: invalidate and stop the formal H1 evaluation
completeness.unannotated_claim_pipeline_failure: record separately; never convert to a labeled example

interpretation_limits: document grouping guarantees only cited-document and normalized-claim separation under the frozen split protocol
it does not guarantee independence of retrieved candidate documents, pretrained knowledge or scientific domains
ranking quality is not classification accuracy, probability calibration or deployment utility
